probe_inputs.vm_boot_script:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,socket,json
p=pathlib.Path('/home/tdp/.cache/agent-computer-kube-vm');q=pathlib.Path('/tmp/agent-computer-kube-vm/qemu')
env=os.environ.copy();env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(q/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')
if not (p/'id_ed25519').exists():subprocess.run(['ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',str(p/'id_ed25519')],check=True)
(p/'meta-data').write_text('instance-id: ac-kube-validation-001\nlocal-hostname: ac-kube-validation\n')
(p/'user-data').write_text('#cloud-config\nusers:\n  - name: ac-test\n    groups: [sudo]\n    shell: /bin/bash\n    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n    lock_passwd: true\n    ssh_authorized_keys:\n      - '+(p/'id_ed25519.pub').read_text().strip()+'\nssh_pwauth: false\ndisable_root: true\n')
subprocess.run([str(q/'usr/bin/genisoimage'),'-quiet','-output',str(p/'seed.iso'),'-volid','cidata','-joliet','-rock',str(p/'user-data'),str(p/'meta-data')],check=True,env=env)
if not (p/'disk.qcow2').exists():subprocess.run([str(q/'usr/bin/qemu-img'),'create','-f','qcow2','-F','qcow2','-b',str(p/'noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img'),str(p/'disk.qcow2'),'24G'],check=True,env=env)
ports=[]
for _ in range(2):
 with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));ports.append(s.getsockname()[1])
ssh_port,api_port=ports
args=[str(q/'usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64'),'-enable-kvm','-cpu','host','-smp','4','-m','6144','-machine','q35','-display','none','-vga','none','-monitor','none','-serial','file:'+str(p/'serial.log'),'-L',str(q/'usr/share/qemu'),'-bios',str(q/'usr/share/seabios/bios-256k.bin'),'-drive','file='+str(p/'disk.qcow2')+',if=virtio,format=qcow2','-drive','file='+str(p/'seed.iso')+',media=cdrom,readonly=on','-netdev',f'user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{ssh_port}-:22,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{api_port}-:6443','-device','virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0,romfile=']
process=subprocess.Popen(args,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=(p/'qemu.log').open('ab'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
(p/'vm.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':process.pid,'ssh_port':ssh_port,'api_port':api_port}));print('VM',process.pid,ssh_port,api_port)
